title: specanchor spec v1
description: A specification derived from one or more approved rules. open_brackets counts unresolved [OPEN — ...] placeholders in the body; it must be 0 before the spec is releasable, and a spec with open brackets cannot enter a sprint (Definition of Ready).

body.description: The acceptance criteria. One screen maximum — exceeding the limit is a generation-time failure.

open_brackets.description: Count of unresolved [OPEN — pending expert decision] placeholders in body. Must be 0 before release; kept visible, never silently resolved by a tool.

approved_by.description: Domain expert. Required before implementation starts (human gate #1).
